title: Trae IDE enables router-based home security without cameras #traeide #drewview #hometech
description:
Trae IDE transformed Wi-Fi routers into home security cameras without using physical cameras. By analyzing changes in Wi-Fi signal patterns caused by movement, the app detects people anywhere in the house, even through walls. 

This low-code solution leverages AI agents to autonomously build, debug, and deploy the application after users simply paste a GitHub repo and describe their goals. The approach highlights how AI can simplify complex software development and convert existing smart home infrastructure into advanced security systems.

The technology demonstrates the potential for non-invasive, privacy-preserving home surveillance using widely available devices. It also signals a shift toward intelligent automation tools that enable innovation without requiring extensive coding expertise.
